style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the whole is a golden satin ribbon: golden satin keys in its own colour family, a rose-pink Enter as the treat of the same world, never red or violet

images.why: Look: 'A fraction card over a bar of the same whole', labelled Whole and 100%, recut into 'as many equal parts as the denominator says' up to a hundred, with 'a second whole bar' on the fourth phase; a length cut into parts is a ribbon (IMAGES.md 3), and a hundred parts rules out a skin per piece, so the whole is one light, even ribbon the deep-blue shading and near-black cuts read on
images.prompt: A long straight length of pale golden-yellow satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth, soft sheen that glows gently along its length, the same light buttery gold from end to end.
